newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 3.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 3.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to Aug 3, 1997
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
CONTEST ENTRY DEADLINES:

ADVERTISING MARKETING EFFECTIVENESS - Global competition sponsored by The New York Festivals, designed to recognise effectiveness and creativity of advertising and marketing campaigns from a global vantage point. Entry fee $375. Deadline for entries: September 30, 1997. Contact: 1 914 238 4481. Web site: http://www.nyfests.com
FRIDAY, JULY 11

LONDON - The Absolute Essentials: How to Create Customers and Keep Them. A one-day course on direct marketing, presented by The Institute of Direct Marketing. Cumberland Hotel, London. Contact: (44) 181 977 5705
MONDAY, JULY 14

LONDON - Sports Sponsorship conference. Includes how to identify potential sponsors, prepare sponsorship bids, understand what sponsors want from the relationship, what to do when things go wrong and you find yourself going into receivership. Forum Hotel, London. Contact: (44) 171 434 3711. (two-day conference July 14-15)
TUESDAY, JULY 15

LONDON - Sports Sponsorship conference. Includes how to identify potential sponsors, prepare sponsorship bids, understand what sponsors want from the relationship, what to do when things go wrong and you find yourself going into receivership. Forum Hotel, London. (two-day confernce July 14-15)
THURSDAY, JULY 17

CAMBRIDGE - Advertising Association 1997 Peterhouse Seminar. "How effective is advertising self-regulation and could it be improved?" chaired by Lord Borrie, former director general of fair trading. 2 p.m. July 17 to 5 p.m. July 18. Contact: 0171 828 2771. (two-day seminar, July 17-18)
FRIDAY, JULY 18

CAMBRIDGE - Advertising Association 1997 Peterhouse Seminar. "How effective is advertising self-regulation and could it be improved?" Chaired by Lord Borrie, former director general of fair trading. 2 p.m. July 17 to 5 p.m. July 18. Contact: 0171 828 2771. (two-day seminar, July 17-18)
THURSDAY, JULY 24

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)
FRIDAY, JULY 25

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)
